name: Schengen Short-Stay Entry

requirements.blocker_text: Slovenia is a full Schengen member. EU/EEA citizens enter with a valid ID document, no time limit before formal residence registration is required for longer stays. Nationals of countries on the EU's visa-exempt list may enter without a visa; other nationalities need a Schengen short-stay (Type C) visa, issued through Slovenian diplomatic/consular posts, or a long-stay (Type D) visa/national residence permit for longer purposes. All short-stay entrants (visa-exempt or visa-holding) are capped at 90 days within any rolling 180-day period across the whole Schengen area, or until visa expiry if sooner.
requirements.fix_path: For non-visa-exempt nationalities, apply for a Schengen short-stay (Type C) visa at a Slovenian consulate before travel.

evidence_required.document: Passport valid 3+ months beyond the stay

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days within any 180-day period (Schengen-wide)

sources.title: Portal GOV.SI (Government of the Republic of Slovenia) -- Schengen visa policy, visa-exempt access, and the 90/180-day short-stay rule
